US House Votes to Limit President Trump's War Powers on Iran

The U.S. House of Representatives has voted to limit President Trump's authority to engage in military action against Iran. This marks the third such vote by the House. The resolution requires the President to either halt military action against Iran or seek Congressional approval. Seven Republican representatives defected from their party to vote in favor of the resolution. This action reflects growing discontent within Congress regarding the conflict with Iran and the President's war powers.
